Sub-skills / 判斷項目: words / phrases / clauses 的平行；paired structures；not only…but also；both…and 等
Effective / Boundary Rule: 需真正形成結構對稱與表意增強；僅出現 paired conjunction 不代表有效。

Sub-skills / 判斷項目: 長短句交替；simple / compound / complex variation；不同句首；避免單一句型反覆
Effective / Boundary Rule: 多樣性必須服務 clarity / rhythm；刻意複雜化或機械換句型不算高分特徵。

Sub-skills / 判斷項目: relative clauses；noun clauses；adverb clauses；多層從屬但仍清楚易讀
Effective / Boundary Rule: 複雜句需清楚且受控；若結構錯誤或造成可讀性下降，不算 EFFECTIVE。

Sub-skills / 判斷項目: V-ing participial phrases；p.p. phrases；reduced relative clauses；with + O + complement 等簡化
Effective / Boundary Rule: 只有正確且自然地壓縮資訊才算；dangling / illogical modifier 應標 MISUSED。

Sub-skills / 判斷項目: negative inversion；only + adv inversion；so/such inversion；conditional inversion 等
Effective / Boundary Rule: 不得因出現倒裝形式就自動稱讚；必須語法正確且有合理強調功能。

Sub-skills / 判斷項目: appositives；插入補充；dash structures；colon expansion；non-restrictive supplementary phrases
Effective / Boundary Rule: 需增加資訊密度或清晰度；若插入造成歧義或句構失控，不算 EFFECTIVE。

Sub-skills / 判斷項目: 避免不必要重複；不同詞彙表達相關概念；動詞／形容詞／名詞變化
Effective / Boundary Rule: 不為換字而換字；近義詞若造成語意偏差不算有效。

Sub-skills / 判斷項目: specific verbs；precise nouns；適切 adjective/adverb；細微語義差異
Effective / Boundary Rule: 以語意精準與情境適切為核心，不以字詞難度判分。

Sub-skills / 判斷項目: sophisticated but natural vocabulary；academic vocabulary；避免硬塞難字
Effective / Boundary Rule: 只有自然、正確且符合語境的進階詞彙才算；misuse 應降為 PARTIALLY_EFFECTIVE / MISUSED。

Sub-skills / 判斷項目: verb–noun；adjective–noun；adverb–adjective；prepositional collocations；慣用搭配
Effective / Boundary Rule: 重點是 natural usage；僅使用固定片語但語境不合不算。

Sub-skills / 判斷項目: synonyms；near-synonyms；phrase replacement；conceptual rewording；避免原詞重複
Effective / Boundary Rule: 改述需保留原意且自然；概念偏移或硬換字不算。

Sub-skills / 判斷項目: addition；contrast；cause-effect；example；concession；sequence；summary transitions；隱性轉承
Effective / Boundary Rule: 不以 transition words 數量判分；真正重點是語意關係自然、必要且不機械。

Sub-skills / 判斷項目: repetition of key concepts；synonym chain；semantic field；superordinate/subordinate terms；lexical recurrence
Effective / Boundary Rule: 需形成可追蹤的概念鏈；單純重複同一字不一定是高分特徵。

Sub-skills / 判斷項目: this/that/these/those；it/they；such + N；the former/latter；clear backward reference
Effective / Boundary Rule: 所有指涉必須清楚可回指；ambiguous reference 不算有效。

Sub-skills / 判斷項目: given → new information；sentence-to-sentence progression；A→B→C development；避免 abrupt topic jumps
Effective / Boundary Rule: 重點是新舊資訊推進自然；單句各自正確但主題跳躍不算。

Sub-skills / 判斷項目: 前段→後段邏輯承接；bridge sentence；concept carry-over；段落功能順序
Effective / Boundary Rule: 段落需有功能性推進；只在段首放 moreover / however 不等於有效銜接。

Sub-skills / 判斷項目: introduction–conclusion echo；motif callback；key phrase return；opening image revisited；central idea recurrence
Effective / Boundary Rule: 必須形成有意義的結構回扣，而非機械重複開頭字句。

Sub-skills / 判斷項目: contrast；antithesis；juxtaposition；before/after；light/dark contrast
Effective / Boundary Rule: 需產生明確修辭效果或概念張力；一般 compare/contrast 組織不一定是本 Feature。

Sub-skills / 判斷項目: rhetorical parallelism；Rule of Three；anaphora 首語重複；repetition；climactic sequence
Effective / Boundary Rule: 需有節奏或修辭效果；一般句法平行但無風格功能可只標 H1-1。

Sub-skills / 判斷項目: question opening；challenge question；reflective question；question-answer pattern
Effective / Boundary Rule: 真正目的須是引導、挑戰或反思；純資訊問句不算。

Sub-skills / 判斷項目: simile；metaphor；analogy；extended metaphor；personification
Effective / Boundary Rule: 比喻需清楚且恰當；混亂比喻或 clichéd misuse 可標 PARTIALLY_EFFECTIVE / MISUSED。

Sub-skills / 判斷項目: visual / auditory / tactile / olfactory / gustatory imagery；sensory details；concrete imagery
Effective / Boundary Rule: 需增加可感知性與具體性；堆疊形容詞但無清晰意象不算。

Sub-skills / 判斷項目: punch line；aphoristic ending；callback ending；contrast ending；rhetorical question ending；memorable final sentence
Effective / Boundary Rule: 聚焦結尾的表達力度；與 H5-6 Meaningful Closure（內容收束）及 H3-6 Callback（結構呼應）可並存。

Sub-skills / 判斷項目: central idea；controlling idea；thesis（論說文）；paragraph focus；purpose awareness
Effective / Boundary Rule: 不限定論說文；任何文類都可依其核心目的與焦點判斷。

Sub-skills / 判斷項目: specificity；concretization；effective examples；illustration；explanation；detail；Idea → Explain → Extend
Effective / Boundary Rule: 需實質推進內容；單純拉長句子或重述同一點不算。

Sub-skills / 判斷項目: cause-effect；causal chain；problem-solution；condition-result；reason-result；process development
Effective / Boundary Rule: 重點是思路關係清楚且合理；形式上有 because/therefore 但推理跳躍不算。

主技巧: 比較、分類與多角度分析
Sub-skills / 判斷項目: compare & contrast；categorization；grouping；multiple perspectives；stakeholder analysis；different dimensions
Effective / Boundary Rule: 不要求每篇都多角度；只有 task/內容真的適用時才產生 positive evidence。

Sub-skills / 判斷項目: lesson learned；meaning；implication；perspective shift；deeper interpretation；「so what?」
Effective / Boundary Rule: 需超越表面重述並提出意義、洞見或視角變化；空泛人生大道理不算。

Sub-skills / 判斷項目: synthesis；resolution；implication；return to central idea；answering the task；future implication
Effective / Boundary Rule: 聚焦內容／思想是否真正收束；與 H4-6 的修辭力度、H3-6 的前後呼應可同時成立。
